about.title: About Me
about.subtitle_line1: Mason with 25 years of construction experience.
about.bio_p1: I've been working in construction for 25 years. I specialize in masonry — bricklaying, partitions, demolition — and related work: tiling, facades with insulation, and plastering.
about.bio_p2: I work with a few trusted partners. I personally lead every job from the first site visit to handover. What we agree on is what gets done — no subcontractors, no communication mix-ups.

step1.title: Site Visit & Quote
step1.desc: I come to take a look, measure, and send you a quote within a few days. Free and non-binding.

step2.title: We Agree on a Date
step2.desc: I don't take on more jobs than I can handle. The date I promise is the date I deliver.

step3.title: Honest Work
step3.desc: I work as if I were doing it in my own home. I clean up after myself.
